summary: Validated P0 fix for Equipos overrides resolution by segment in QuotesTable.jsx. The resolveBizSub helper now correctly resolves Equipos to sub='clientes_pyme' (segment PYME), so action override keys equipos|clientes_pyme|<action> match.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <tbody> and <tr>. Cosmetic but should be cleaned up to avoid hydration mismatches in QuotesTable.jsx rows.

critical_code_review_comments: QuotesTable.jsx fix is correct: resolveBizSub returns sub='clientes_pyme'/'clientes_corp' for Equipos by client_segment/sede. Fallback to `${biz}|_|${actionId}` is preserved for legacy overrides.
Minor: hydration warning about <span> inside <tr>/<tbody> in QuotesTable rows (logged in browser console) — not blocking but worth cleaning up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug 'Equipos overrides not applied in Cotizaciones grid' has been fixed and validated end-to-end in preview. The override key shape `equipos|clientes_pyme|<action>` is now correctly produced by resolveBizSub on the frontend; relabel and authorization gating both work. No further regression observed.
rca of the issue: Root cause: In QuotesTable.jsx, resolveBizSub returned sub=null for Equipos, so getActionMeta looked up `equipos|_|<action>` which never matched the persisted override keys `equipos|clientes_corp|<action>` / `equipos|clientes_pyme|<action>` introduced in Iter50. Fix: when category=='equipment', resolve sub from q.client_segment/q.sede (CORP→clientes_corp, default→clientes_pyme). Verified live: Aprobación correctly disabled for non-allowed user and Cobranza correctly relabeled to 'Registrar pago' via override on COT-2026-05-034-PYME.
